title: Kotlin — From Beginner to Professional: Final Assessment

topic_distribution.topic: Core language, syntax, types, control flow, functions, null safety and collections
Object-oriented design, functional programming, generics and error/I/O patterns
Gradle, Java interop, coroutines, testing, reflection and advanced language features
Software engineering, integration and platform specialization concepts

project_submission: Human-reviewed practical projects. No arbitrary learner Kotlin code runs inside the CodeLeaf FastAPI process or production web container.
remediation_policy: Recommend revisiting lessons and their protected checks for missed topic outcomes; exam attempt persistence/authorization must be confirmed in the live assessment service.
status_note: Blueprint based on the Kotlin.pdf coverage checklist. Do not advertise a live exam or certificate until a backend exam runner enforces server-side sampling, grading, attempt state, and passing rules.
